data.narrative:
Percepto is a Series C-stage autonomous systems company in the Drones & Autonomous sector. The company has raised $128M to date across its funding history. The valuation comparison set consists of 6 private peers in the sector, including Zipline, Joby Aviation, Nuro, Archer Aviation, and Elroy Air, though no public comparables exist in this specialized domain.

Given the sparsity of same-stage and valuation-tier peers within the Drones & Autonomous category, a formal peer-median approach was not applicable. Instead, valuation relied on stage-progression methodology, applying a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical of Series C advancement to the $128M raised proxy, yielding $218M. This single-method triangulation produces a supported range of $185M to $250M, with a median estimate of $218M. The low-end reflects downside sensitivity; the high-end incorporates modest upside variance within the stage-progression framework.

Key uncertainties stem from the absence of narrow peer comparables, limiting ability to benchmark revenue multiples, growth rates, or profitability profiles against similar-stage operators. The stage-progression estimate itself depends on whether typical multiplier assumptions hold for this capital-intensive, infrastructure-dependent sector. Refinement would benefit from revenue or EBITDA data, customer concentration metrics, and pathway to positive unit economics.
